instruction.text: Choose the correct verb to complete the sentence in the passive voice.

wrong.text: The past participle of the verb is always used to form the passive, no matter which tense the sentence is in.

atoms.b: The bins are ((++emptied empting empties)) every day.
The parcels are ((++delivered delivery delivers)) to the post office.
The ball is ((++chased chases chasing)) by Sadie.
The windows are ((++cleaned clean cleans)) by the window cleaners.
The floor is ((++swept sweep sweeps)) by Ben and his son, Tyler.
The coffee is ((++made make maker)) by the barista.

instruction.text: Choose the correct verbs to complete the sentence in the present passive voice.

trainers.hint:
To form the present passive, the present form of 'to be' is used alongside the past participle of the main verb.

For example: She is helped.

atoms.b: The tram ((++is are)) ((++driven drives)) by Malcolm.
Becca ((++is are)) always ((++asked asks)) for help in class.

instruction.text: Choose the correct verbs to complete the sentence in the past passive voice.

trainers.hint:
To form the past passive, the past form of 'to be' is used alongside the past participle of the main verb.

For example: She was helped.

atoms.b: They ((++were was)) ((++sent send)) a card by their grandparents.
Leila ((++was were)) ((++told tell)) to complete her homework.
